summary: [FE][MT] Verify one Create Work session: Master Data spelling is applied when a value is entered (typed with Enter, pasted), partial text is not converted, free text stays exactly as typed, and several free-text spellings are all stored
description_wiki:
*Scenario:* Checks one Create Work session with typed, pasted and free-text Deck values in three Work Breakdown rows.

*Precondition:* A user with View Worklist permission (see [Role & Permission|https://pttep.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/sites/TurnaroundManagement/Shared%20Documents/03%20Development/Role%20%26%20Permission%20V.2.xlsx?d=wa5e5a9a2071b4ed7b3ef83c4cf0dffd9&csf=1&web=1&e=3stFwC]) is logged in. {{Main Deck}} and {{Cellar Deck}} are Master Data Deck values. {{Dock Area}} and {{Pier Side}} are not in Master Data. Worklist {{WL-A}} holds {{WK-19a}} with Deck {{Dock Area}} and {{WK-19b}} with Deck {{dock area}}. The text {{main deck}} is copied from a text editor. The Create Work page has three Work Breakdown rows.

*Navigation Path:* Planning tab > Plan Card > Worklist item > Worklist page of {{WL-A}} > Create Work > Manual Create.
